dataList.name: Battōjutsu [Kurokumo]
dataList.desc: Turn 3 Start: This unit equips "Battō Shisei" in its Skill Slots and uses it repeatedly during this turn - Said Turn Start: Gain (25 + (missing HP percentage on self) / 2)[SharpSensibility] (rounded down) - During said turn, when hit once by a Sinner's E.G.O Skill with 1 base Atk Weight, cancel "Ready to Draw" and activate the following effects (each Skill only counts as hitting once): · Change [SharpSensibility] to 0 · Gain +1 for all E.G.O Resource · Gain 5 [Vulnerable] for the next turn; Clash Power -5 for "Kumogiri" and "Rend Space" - Repeat the above every 2 turns. Every time this unit enters this pattern, +1 to the number of hits required to cancel "Ready to Draw" (max +3) Turn Start: If this unit had "Battō Shisei" equipped at last Turn End, use "Kumogiri" When this unit's HP drops to 50% or below for the first time in this Encounter, immediately end the turn; then, if there are fewer than 5 "Kurokumo Clan" allies other than this unit and Jun, summon up to 5 allies comprised of Adept Kurokumo Henchwoman and Tired Kurokumo Henchwoman. (above units are summoned at 30 SP) After entering a different pattern, gain the following effects: - Deal +(missing HP percentage on self)% damage (max 100%) - Replace "Kumogiri" with "Rend Space"
dataList.summary:
Every 2 turns, use "Battō Shisei" followed by "Kumogiri"
"Battō Shisei" Skill is canceled when hit by E.G.O Skills
At 50%- HP, summon allies and deal more damage
dataList.flavor: The Kurokumo Clan owes its signature sword-drawing technique to its very first Patriarch. Keep a wary eye on the bank of black clouds all you like, but you will never predict where the flash of the lightning-fast sword will strike, or when.

dataList.name: Patriarch of the Third Family, a Kurokumo Clan Subsidiary
dataList.desc: Allied "Kurokumo Clan" units, including this unit, gain 1 [BlackCloudBladeEnemy] for the Encounter - When an affected unit's HP drops 50% or below for the first time in this Encounter, additionally gain 1 [EngageToBattleEnemy] Whenever an allied "Kurokumo Clan" unit is defeated, Min & Max Speed +1 for Mine, Patriarch of the Kurokumo Clan's Third Family (max +5 each)
dataList.flavor:
The Kurokumo Clan's reach extends from the South of the City all the way to the East. Its subsidiaries are many, but only the First through the Fourth have each acquired an identity of their own. In the character of each, one may recognize the hand of its Patriarch.

The First rules the Clan. The Second became its keenest blade. The Third enjoys a good battle of blades and the slaughter that comes with it, going wherever there's plenty of both. As for the Fourth... one day the Fourth simply vanished. To where, no one can say.
